title: Octavia Butler and science fiction
summary: She reads everything Octavia Butler wrote.

story.theme_name: Late-career reflections: awards, legacy and life lessons
story.community_name: Life philosophy: faith, karma and how to live

blocks.x: Jeez, how did you know I read her? I read everything she wrote. I don’t know anything about her. I’ve just read every book she’s ever written.
What kind of books does she write?
Science fiction. Wow, where’d you come up with that?
I scoured the bookstores in Seattle for you, to find Octavia Butler books on our first trip to Seattle.
This is a long time ago, yeah. She wrote science fiction. Her stuff – but it wasn’t like aliens and things like that. It was just different, off the beaten path.
